name: Spike - does the CM slot take its weather from race.ini
notes: Install with `npm run weather -- plan pure defer`, then drive this. The plan is two slots: the shared "CM" weather for 5 minutes, then heavy rain for 5. THE POINT IS THE FIRST FIVE MINUTES. Unlike the other weather-plan spikes, this race asks race.ini for a specific weather - Fog, CSP weather type 20 - while still naming the dynamic pureCtrl controller, so race.ini carries both __CM_WEATHER_CONTROLLER=pureCtrl and __CM_WEATHER_TYPE=20. If the opening five minutes are FOGGY, the CM slot really does read race.ini and a generated plan can open on the session's own weather and evolve away from it. If they are anything else - scattered clouds is what PURE falls back to when nothing was asked for - then the CM slot ignores us and every plan has to state its own weather from the first second. Driving this against a race that names no weather proves nothing, which is the mistake worth not repeating. Second thing to note while watching: PURE shows plan times in LOCAL time while our timestamps are UTC, so a plan written for midday appears as 14:00 at UTC+2 - do not read that as the plan being wrong.
